segments.name: North America
segments.description: Makes and upfits specialty vehicles, snow and ice control equipment, airport maintenance machines and fleet solutions for municipal, commercial and fleet customers in North America.
segments.evidence: Aebi Schmidt North America offers a wide range of vehicles, equipment and services primarily across four of our five lines of business: Airport & Chassis, Commercial Trucks, Goods Transport, and Municipal.

segments.name: Europe and the Rest of the World ("ROW")
segments.description: Supplies sweepers, sprayers, blowers, snowplows and slope tractors for airports, municipalities and mountain farming businesses across Europe and the rest of the world.
segments.evidence: In Europe and ROW, we offer a wide range of vehicles, equipment and services primarily across three of our five lines of business: Airport & Chassis, Municipal and Agriculture.

revenueModel.text: Customers such as municipalities, contractors, fleets and business owners pay for vehicles, equipment, spare parts and repair and maintenance services.
revenueModel.evidence: Sales also include revenues generated from selling spare parts as well as repair and maintenance services for these machines.

changes.text: In 2025 the company acquired Shyft and integrated the business into the North America segment.
changes.evidence: In 2025, Shyft was integrated into the North America segment with sales of approximately $378 million for the period from the Acquisition Date through December 31, 2025.

changes.text: During the fourth quarter of 2025 the company changed its financial reporting structure following the completion of the Merger with Shyft.
changes.evidence: During the fourth quarter of 2025, the Company changed its financial reporting structure following the completion of the Merger with Shyft, to align with the executive structure following the Merger.
